data.name: Josselyn
data.gender_notes: Josselyn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin Joscelin, meaning 'Joseph' and 'God's deliverance'. This name has roots in the Old Testament, referencing the biblical figure Joseph, who was saved from potential harm and went on to become a leader and interpreter of dreams. The name Josselyn carries the meaning “God's deliverance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Josselyn usually hope their child will grow to embody god's deliverance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection and deliverance.
data.etymology: Josselyn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's deliverance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Josselyn total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_greek.name: Γιοσέλυν
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός προσθέτει περισσότερο - God adds more
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιοσέλυν είναι παράγωγο του εβραϊκού ονόματος 'Ιωσήφ', που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός προσθέτει περισσότερο'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ιωσήφ συνδέεται με τον πατέρα του Ιησού, τον Ιωσήφ τον Νυμφοφόρο. Το όνομα αυτό έχει μεγάλη σημασία στην παράδοση των Χριστιανών.

in_latin.name: Josselyn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Josselyn derivatur ex hebraico nomine 'Joseph', quod significat 'Deus addit'. In ecclesia primitiva Christiana, nomen Joseph erat nomen sacrum, quod recordabatur de sanctitate et justitia. Nomen Josselyn habet profundam significationem spiritualem et culturalem in traditione Christiana.

It carries a rich biblical heritage, reflecting the idea of divine addition or multiplication. Historically, the name has been associated with qualities of faith, loyalty, and perseverance. In Christian tradition, Josselyn symbolizes spiritual growth and abundance.
